image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of two common iguanas (Iguana iguana) resting closely together. The foreground iguana is in sharp focus, displaying detailed scale texture, a prominent dewlap, and large subtympanic shield. A second iguana is visible immediately behind the first, slightly out of focus. The background consists of blurred green foliage.
